settings.title: Fiscal settings
settings.readOnly: Only the owner can change these settings
settings.morNotice: The official Ministry of Revenues e-invoicing connection is not active yet. It needs the official API specification and credentials, configured by your system administrator on the server. Until then, invoices cannot be sent to MoR and this system does not make your invoices legally compliant.
settings.mockNotice: The mock provider is for testing only. It produces fake MOCK- fiscal numbers and sends nothing to the tax authority.
settings.morConfigured: Server credentials for MoR are present, but the official adapter is not implemented yet.
settings.morNotConfigured: MoR credentials are not configured on the server. Submissions will fail until they are.
